Use to gain a small amount of Idea.

It is said that humans exist as humans precisely because they hold human Idea within them.

A key with a hexagonal grip.\n\nIts pattern does not seem to be of these parts. Why, then, did the ogre carry it?
The Idea of a man who committed every atrocity imaginable.\nTremendous energy can be felt within.
The Idea of Yatsude, who degenerated into a demon.\nAn energy not of this world can be felt within.
The Idea of the Church Beast.\nA proud energy can be felt within.
The Idea of a demon born from the abyss.\nAn indescribable energy can be felt within.
An energy beautiful yet sorrowful, imbued with a heartfelt wish.
The Idea of a fallen Requiem Knight.\nEven in its fall, a proud yet grief-laden energy can be felt within.
The Idea of a high demon.\nAn energy brimming with lust can be felt within.

A crest talisman imbued with enchanting magic.

Use to clad your weapon in an element for a time.
Do not scorn it as a mere enchantment; depending on the wielder's weapon and Intelligence, it can prove formidable.
Temporarily imbues your weapon with Fire

A key that shines white.\nIt carries a faint trace of magic.
A key found on the aerial pilgrim's path
A key picked up in the White Cathedral.\nIt was carried by a High Inquisitor who had fallen to demonhood.
A key found on the roof of the White Cathedral
An utterly ordinary key.\nSave that it has turned black, and its surface seems to writhe...
A key found in the research facility

A shard of stone with the power to draw out the essence of the material it touches.
Can reinforce a weapon up to rank I.

Pieces the size of a chunk or larger are rare and costly, found only on occasion in fertile soil or burial grounds.
Cases of pets that swallowed it turning savage before dying suggest it is harmful to animals.

Opens treasure chests and certain doors, but breaks after one use.

A wire shaped specifically for picking locks.
Though it seems a tool fit only for crime, it was first devised by a dexterous man to help people who had lost their keys.
Opens treasure chests and certain doors
A witch's secret medicine that instantly heals one's wounded body.\nIncreases the maximum number of this medicine you can carry
Increases the maximum number of Witch's Elixirs
A witch's mana draught that instantly restores one's depleted MP.\nIncreases the maximum number of this draught you can carry
Increases the maximum number of Witch's Ethers
By tracing the drawn crest once more in one's own blood, one may return to the place most deeply etched in memory. Blood, after all, may truly be called one's very self.
Return to the last altar you touched
By tracing the drawn crest once more in one's own blood, one may return to the place most deeply etched in memory, but all Idea currently held is lost.
Lose all Idea held and return to the altar
Temporarily imbues your weapon with Holy
A mysterious needle and cloth that can mend torn clothing.

A Crest Ring made from a crystal that holds levitating magic.
The crystal's magic makes weapons slightly lighter, allowing faster attacks.

Its power has waned. It is said that long ago it held enough magic to swing a greatsword as tall as a man like a feather, though the truth is uncertain.

A Crest Ring that glows azure.
Slightly increases the chance of critical hits.

The wearer's intuition is subtly sharpened, raising the odds of dealing a fatal blow.
Intuition is surely an ability one cannot do without to survive in this world.

A Crest Ring, decayed and battered.

Yet it looks to have once been of fine make.
It closely resembles the rings given to wish someone good fortune on a journey, but its owner is surely no longer of this world.
A departure for the world beyond: what a sorrowful tale.

A dully gleaming ring that must once have shone.
Increases STR but lowers HP, MP and INT.

Do not mistake recklessness for courage, lest you end up like its former owner.
Increases STR but lowers HP, MP and INT

A heavily built Crest Ring.
Reduces SP consumed when guarding, but increases SP consumed when attacking.

"O brave one, become the shield that guards all," reads the inscription inside the ring.

A Crest Ring forged from Degraid's Idea.
Enhances a variety of abilities.

He committed every atrocity imaginable, yet this will be the first and last time he ever helps anyone.
That this help should be in the service of revenge speaks of karma indeed.

The Crest Ring of the Prayer Maiden.
Its crystal greatly enhances MP and Intelligence, but lowers Strength and Stamina.

She smiles sorrowfully.
And even while bearing despair, she still prays for peace.

A ring adorned with a shield crest.
Increases HP, and also slightly boosts Strength and Dexterity.

Awarded only to the finest of the Guard.
Yet that it lies here suggests its owner could protect nothing in the end.

A Crest Ring of good fortune.
Greatly increases Luck.

Its shining ornament brings fortune to its wearer, though is it only imagination that misfortune keeps befalling those around them?

A ring with crests of magic amplification drawn on its inner band and its blue ore.
Slightly increases max MP.

A ring of beautifully gleaming blue ore holds an allure like no other for those who wield the power of crests.

A Crest Ring received from Vendetta.

On its back, faded letters read "To Vendetta," suggesting it was a gift she received from someone.
Judging by the ring's age, it must be a memory from long, long ago.
A Crest Ring that increases Intelligence

A ring with crests of Idea absorption drawn on its inner band and its red ore.
Slightly increases HP recovered on Revenge.

The red-glowing ore emanates hatred, sorrow and an iron will.
It must have been worn by someone with feelings of extraordinary strength.

A Crest Ring that looks both red and black.
Increases HP recovered by Revenge Strikes, but lowers attack power.

It is carved not from metal but from some hardened red-black liquid, yet no one dares say aloud what that liquid is.
Increases HP recovered by Revenge Strikes

A ring adorned with an ornament shaped like an angel's wing.
Increases INT but lowers SP and STR.

The mind grows clear and compassion wells up unceasingly, though for one burning with revenge it is scant comfort.
Increases INT but lowers SP and STR

A ring adorned with a crest of lust.
Lowers Intelligence and MP, but raises Strength and Stamina.

Those who wear this ring lose all calm judgment, and the weak-willed come to crave taking the opposite sex for their own by force.
Lowers MP and INT, raises STR and Stamina.

A ring with crests of stamina amplification drawn on its inner band and its green ore.
Slightly increases max Stamina.

Merely gazing upon this ring of brightly shining green ore fills one with vigor.

A Crest Ring set with violet ore.\n\nOf a witch clan skilled in lightning arts, she set out alone in pursuit of her master, but while hunting for ore, her hobby, she was set upon by goblins and made their plaything.
A simple ring of silverwork. Slightly reduces MP consumption.

A flintlock mana pistol handed down
among witches.

By charging the bullets with magic beforehand, even those with weak or little magic can achieve a certain power.
Those of high skill who master its use can bring out power to match.
A colossal crest sword that calls down lightning.\n\nLightning strikes a few seconds after casting; striking it with lightning in the meantime charges it, increasing the power and number of bolts.

A special mist of gunpowder that explodes in reaction to magic and projectiles.

When it senses fire magic in particular, it explodes on a scale several times greater than normal.
To master it without being caught in the blast, your own positioning will be vital.

Witchcraft that sets three flames circling about the caster as protection.

It has little power and will not make foes flinch, but it can cancel out lesser projectiles.
It was originally devised as a defensive spell; in every age, the more gifted one is, the less one neglects caution.
